# Employee Handbook

Security awareness training must be finished by every staff member no later
than thirty days after they join. If it is not completed, VPN access is
temporarily withdrawn until the training is done. The course runs for about
45 minutes and can be found in the learning portal.

Northwind Systems operates on a hybrid schedule. Engineers are expected in
the office on Tuesday and Thursday. Remote-first arrangements exist for
staff hired outside commuting distance of the Tallinn or Berlin offices and
must be documented in the HR system at the time of hire.

Expense reimbursement is processed twice monthly, on the 15th and the last
business day. Submit receipts through the expenses portal within 60 days of
purchase. Expenses over 500 EUR require line-manager approval before the
purchase, not after.

This document is maintained by the People Operations team. For questions,
contact peopleops@northwind.example. Last reviewed March 2026.
